issues.title: Function reservations and contributor coordination
issues.author: ReaperOfVeriod
issues.body:
Purpose
Coordinate function matching across contributors, agents, branches and worktrees so the same functions are not attempted in parallel.
How to reserve work

Each contributor keeps one comment on this issue and edits only their own comment as their scope changes.
Before starting or assigning matching work, read the other active comments and check for overlap.
Reserve a manageable set of functions you intend to attempt next, up to 500 unfinished distinct functions across your branches,…
